issue.title: Show bob blocked reasons in the Mac Refs inspector

task_type_fields.proposal: Decode the optional schema-1 blocked_by reason array and selected task scheduled/priority facts in Bob Mac Capture RefsCore; show wake date, open prerequisite titles, and blocked-project context in the Refs inspector, using bob-provided facts and a graceful older-bob fallback. Source: bob-cli-99.4 note 1 and plan:202610/reading_board.md. Rust RefRow already exposes the fields; current RefsCore ignores blocked_by. Preserve existing reading lanes, actions, and the in-progress bob-cli-9d Newest mode; compile portable and changed macOS targets under that repo AGENTS.md.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The Reading Board epic expressly excludes Bob Mac Capture changes; additive JSON compatibility is already provided. This is a bounded decoder/presentation addition, not a defect or remaining Reading Board acceptance.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-99.4 note 1 explicitly proposed the Mac inspector follow-up after the Reading Board shipped an additive blocked_by contract.
